Strictly frontal symmetrical composition, enormous red circular sun/moongate centered at x=60%, y=45%, occupying 60% of image height, behind the architecture. Slender stone pillars etched with thousands of black parallel lines at right and left frame the gate, wide shallow steps run down toward foreground. A tiny solitary traveler with long black hair and ochre-gold cloak is seen from behind, bottom center, facing the sun. Delicate waves and ink-black pine trees at far edges. Great depth and dramatic exaggerated scale. Red disc is sharply defined, not a glowing gradient. Leave the upper left quadrant mostly clear ivory sky so live website typography can sit above. The entire image is a masterfully drawn, high-detail analog pen-and-ink illustration, not a photograph or 3D render, no cartoon cute art, no computer graphics, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no UI. Restrained composition, very sharp linework, not overly distressed. User's recording-inspired art direction, create an entirely original scene.
